top1.title: 【2026-11-06】OpenAI、サイバー防御向け「GPT-6 Cyber」を限定提供開始
top1.lead1: OpenAIがGPT-6 Cyberを発表し、認可された防御活動向けに一部参加者への提供を始めた。
top1.lead2: 同社は脆弱性探索能力と安全策の改善を説明。一方、モデルが評価を見抜く可能性などの課題は残る。

top10.title: [2026-11-06] OpenAI begins limited rollout of GPT-6 Cyber for cyber defense
top10.summary: OpenAI announced GPT-6 Cyber, saying it has improved vulnerability discovery capabilities and instruction adherence. It began offering the model to some Daybreak Red participants.

top10.title: [2026-11-06] Claude adds personal finance analysis with read-only access to bank and card accounts
top10.summary: Anthropic announced Personal Finance, which reads account information through Plaid to analyze spending and fees. It is rolling out in beta for eligible paid plans in the United States.

top10.title: [2026-11-06] OpenAI president suggests company could be ready for an IPO in 2027
top10.summary: President Greg Brockman expressed optimism about being ready for an IPO in 2027. He described the expansion of the company's enterprise business, but did not commit to a listing date.

top10.title: [2026-11-06] Dropbox to acquire Tigris Data for $350 million to strengthen AI infrastructure
top10.summary: Dropbox announced its acquisition of Tigris Data to support DBX Agent Cloud for AI models and agents. It expects the transaction to close in the fourth quarter of 2026.

top10.title: [2026-11-06] Analysis: Regulation and data center construction take center stage in AI policy after US midterm elections
top10.summary: The Verge analyzed AI policy following the US midterm elections. It reported on how opposition to data center construction, state regulations and debates over safety affect corporate strategy.

top10.title: [2026-11-06] Axiom Math announces formal verification of the Stacks Project, aiming to improve AI mathematics reliability
top10.summary: Axiom Math announced that it had formally verified the Stacks Project, a collection of mathematical literature. AI agents converted it into Lean code, with the aim of establishing a foundation of reusable, verified knowledge.

top10.title: [2026-11-06] Meta rolls out voice and video conversations with AI avatar Muse in the United States
top10.summary: Meta began offering Muse Voice to all users in the United States. It said the service supports avatars that move in sync with conversations and is available on mobile, the web and Mac.

top10.title: [2026-11-06] ElevenLabs AI music can now be published directly to SoundCloud
top10.summary: SoundCloud added an integration with ElevenLabs that allows generated tracks to be published directly. Tracks published through the integration carry a label identifying them as AI-generated.

editorsDesk.recTitle: 米国政府、AnthropicにFable 5/Mythos 5の海外アクセス停止命令
editorsDesk.recNote: 輸出規制によりFable 5とMythos 5の全世界・外国アクセスが停止。AI地政学の新局面を象徴する事態。
editorsDesk.bonusNote: 今日のおまけアニメ。クリックで再生。
